# AgentScout

> AgentScout is a curated directory of 1064 AI agent tools for builders and ready-to-use products. Facts are verified; pricing is as makers state it.

Site: https://agentscouthq.com/
X: https://x.com/AgentScoutHQ
Contact: support@agentscouthq.com

## Machine-readable catalog

- [tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/tools.json): full catalog
- [sitemap.xml](https://agentscouthq.com/sitemap.xml): all public pages

## Recently added
- [All new tools, last 30 days](https://agentscouthq.com/new.html)

- [Freeday](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/freeday.html) (added 2026-10-18): Enterprise AI agent platform that deploys agents to handle complete business workflows, with outcome-based pricing.
- [Sigma AI Browser](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/sigma-ai-browser.html) (added 2026-10-18): Free private web browser with a built-in AI agent, local AI and ad blocker.
- [Rep AI](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/rep-ai.html) (added 2026-10-18): AI shopping and customer service agent for e-commerce brands that handles product discovery, support and helpdesk work.
- [Aimdoc](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/aimdoc.html) (added 2026-10-18): AI agents that connect to your product and systems to deliver work for your customers, metered and monitored.
- [BaseAI](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/baseai.html) (added 2026-10-18): Web AI framework from Langbase for building AI agents with memory (RAG) and deploying them serverless.
- [Agentman](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/agentman.html) (added 2026-10-18): AI agents that run healthcare practice operations across phone calls, faxes and payer portals, with staff approving final actions.
- [Ask-AI](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/ask-ai.html) (added 2026-10-18): AI customer experience platform for B2B SaaS support teams with AI agents, support analytics and no-code automation.
- [Fabi.ai](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/fabi-ai.html) (added 2026-10-18): AI data analysis platform that combines SQL, Python and AI automation to get insights from your data.
- [Extruct AI](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/extruct-ai.html) (added 2026-10-18): Company research API for AI that finds and researches companies from a 10M-company index or the live web, with sources.
- [AskYourDatabase](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/askyourdatabase.html) (added 2026-10-18): Chat-with-your-database tool that answers natural-language questions over Postgres, MySQL, BigQuery, Snowflake and more with SQL and charts.
- [Alloy](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/alloy.html) (added 2026-10-18): AI prototyping tool for product managers that clones your product so you can make changes and share high-fidelity prototypes.
- [a0.dev](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/a0-dev.html) (added 2026-10-18): AI app builder for iOS and Android that generates production mobile apps and ships them to the App Store and Google Play.
